tools.name: search_startups
tools.description: Search the Security Startups directory of young security companies. Filters combine with AND. Returns public fields and each company's page URL, alphabetical by name (not a ranking).

tools.name: get_startup
tools.description: Get one listed company by slug (or exact name): every public field plus its page URL.

tools.name: check_if_listed
tools.description: Check whether a company appears in the directory (name or slug contains the text). When it does not, the result says how a person can get it listed.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every security-company category with its slug, description, company count and page URL.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: The list in numbers: five aggregates of the listed companies (category, funding stage, headquarters, founded year, minimum disclosed funding), each with n, coverage, caveat, method, as-of date, CSV and chart URL. CC BY 4.0 with attribution.

tools.name: get_stats_history
tools.description: Quarterly snapshots of the same aggregates and one series per chart across snapshots. Never interpolated: one snapshot is one point. CC BY 4.0 with attribution.
